messages.subject: Come see what’s growing in Godly Kids 🌱
messages.body:
Your family’s next Bible adventure is waiting. Come back to Godly Kids and explore an island you can help grow together.

Clear space, tend a garden, and build a home for the friends you meet along the way. Then follow Bible adventures from Creation to Noah’s Ark and Abraham.

Open Godly Kids with your existing account and take a look around together.

messages.subject: A Bible story can open a whole new adventure
messages.body:
Here’s something to try together in Godly Kids: set sail for a Bible adventure.

Illustrated stories and read-along narration help children follow along. Complete story adventures to unlock characters and treasures, then welcome those characters to your home island.

After your next story, ask your child: “What stood out to you?” A small conversation can make this time together even more meaningful.

messages.subject: Your family’s island is waiting 🏝️
messages.body:
If you haven’t had a chance to come back to Godly Kids, here’s a simple place to start: one story, then a little time building together.

Plant something in your garden, build a home, or say hello to a character you’ve unlocked. Little by little, your island becomes a place your family helps shape.

We’d love to hear what your kids enjoy. Hit reply and tell us about your adventure.
